text: さっきから　だまって　みてりゃ…　おまえは　なんなんだよ　あいつらの　オトモダチか？

structure.jp: さっきから　だまって　みてりゃ…
structure.en: I've been watching quietly for a while, and...

structure.jp: おまえは　なんなんだよ
あいつらの　オトモダチか？

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: The ば ending means 'if' or 'when'. みていれば is squeezed to みてりゃ in rough speech, and だまって みてりゃ is a set way to say 'here I am watching without a word, and then you...'. みてりゃ = 'when I've been watching'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ (short for のだ) added to a question word demands an explanation; after なん it needs な first. なんなんだ = 'just what are you?'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: だまって　みてりゃ
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb before another verb can tell in what state the second thing is done. だまって みて = 'watching while keeping quiet'.
